        name: str
        args: dict[str, Any]
        fingerprint: str = ""
        id: str = ""

        def model_post_init(self, __context: Any) -> None:

            self.fingerprint = fingerprint
            self.id = fingerprint[:8]

from dspy.adapters.types.tool import ToolCalls, _canonicalize_args, _compute_tool_call_fingerprint

# Basic test
tc = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='search', args={'query': 'hello'})
print('fingerprint:', tc.fingerprint)
print('id:', tc.id)
assert len(tc.fingerprint) == 64, f'fingerprint not 64 chars: {len(tc.fingerprint)}'
assert len(tc.id) == 8, f'id not 8 chars: {len(tc.id)}'
assert tc.fingerprint == tc.id * 8 or tc.fingerprint.startswith(tc.id)

# Determinism: same call, different key order / whitespace
tc2 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='search', args={'query': 'hello'})
assert tc.fingerprint == tc2.fingerprint

tc3 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='search', args={'query': '  hello  '})
assert tc.fingerprint == tc3.fingerprint, 'whitespace trimming failed'

# Different arg order
tc4 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='search', args={'b': 2, 'a': 1})
tc5 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='search', args={'a': 1, 'b': 2})
assert tc4.fingerprint == tc5.fingerprint, 'key order should not matter'

# Different name -> different fingerprint
tc6 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='translate', args={'query': 'hello'})
assert tc.fingerprint != tc6.fingerprint

# Tuples -> lists
tc7 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='t', args={'x': (1, 2, 3)})
tc8 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='t', args={'x': [1, 2, 3]})
assert tc7.fingerprint == tc8.fingerprint, 'tuple->list should match'

# Numeric/bool preserved (no coercion)
tc9 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='n', args={'x': True, 'y': 1})
tc10 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='n', args={'x': True, 'y': 1})
assert tc9.fingerprint == tc10.fingerprint

# Different values -> different fingerprint
tc11 = ToolCalls.ToolCall(name='n', args={'x': False, 'y': 1})
assert tc9.fingerprint != tc11.fingerprint

# from_dict_list
tcs = ToolCalls.from_dict_list([{'name': 'search', 'args': {'query': 'hello'}}])
assert tcs.tool_calls[0].fingerprint == tc.fingerprint
assert tcs.tool_calls[0].id == tc.id

# canonicalize helper
assert _canonicalize_args({'b': 1, 'a': ' x '}) == {'a': 'x', 'b': 1}
assert _canonicalize_args((1, 2)) == [1, 2]
assert _canonicalize_args({'nested': {'z': 1, 'y': (True, 2)}}) == {'nested': {'y': [True, 2], 'z': 1}}
assert _canonicalize_args(42) == 42
assert _canonicalize_args(3.14) == 3.14
assert _canonicalize_args(True) == True
assert _canonicalize_args(None) is None

print('All assertions passed!')
"
